name: DevCycle
description: Creates, targets and cleans up feature flags from AI coding assistants through a hosted MCP server and CLI, with self-targeting overrides and usage analytics.

skills.name: Manage Feature Flags
skills.description: Creates, updates, enables and deletes feature flags and their variables, and cleans up flags that are no longer needed.

skills.name: Self-Targeting Overrides
skills.description: Sets and clears self-targeting overrides so a developer can test a flag variation without changing it for users.

skills.name: Flag Evaluation Analytics
skills.description: Reports total evaluations per feature or project so the assistant can see which flags are in use and how often.

skills.name: SDK Install Guides
skills.description: Returns DevCycle SDK install guides and code examples for the project's language when wiring flags into code.
